rows.behavior: kmctl check passes when every folder directly under .okf/prototypes/ has a README.md.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits nonzero or reports a prototype finding on that fixture

rows.behavior: A prototype whose nested folder has no README.md still passes.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check reports a prototype finding for a folder below a prototype

rows.behavior: kmctl check fails and names the folder when a prototype has no README.md.
rows.fails_when: kmctl check exits 0, or the finding does not name the folder under check name prototype
